correctness.rationale: Independent product factorization from iid digits shows μhat(m)=Πj[1+Σ_i exp(-2πi m_i/b^j)]/(d+1); factor out common b powers to primitive q. The exact identity (d+1)^2−|Σ_{i=0}^d z_i|²=Σ_{r<s}|z_r−z_s|² forces at least d unequal N-th-root pairs and the minimum chord gap 4 sin²(π/b^j), giving each product factor and convergence. Equality for every scale and a sufficiently large N forbidding residue aliasing forces two phase classes of sizes 1,d with representatives differing exactly ±1; yields precisely listed frequencies. Fourier characters diagonalize convolution and attain power contraction. Fresh independent bounded enumeration d=2,3 and b=2,3,4 over integer boxes [-3,3]^d matched every predicted maximizing frequency, with no mask-bound violations; proof, not enumeration, establishes infinite claim.
